debate.why: Senate candidates Dan Sullivan and Mary Peltola argue opposite sides on stage, rebutting and interrupting each other inside a moderated debate.

exchanges.b_side: That's a lie, Sullivan took Epstein money himself
exchanges.retention: It opens on "Mary took 140,000 in Epstein money," a charge a stranger wants to hear answered. Peltola cuts in right away, and for a few seconds nobody knows if she'll deny it or hit back. The last line turns the charge around: "Dan Sullivan has taken $10,000."

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Mary took 140,000 in Epstein money and paying her salary.
